description:
From the 2026-07-31 adversarial review. Two adapter-side defects that hang on the same unverified LINEAR(...) question as the tracked item snowflake-clustering-key-live-verification-20260730 - that item currently names only the introspector's defensive parse, so these are additional sites (the tracked item is understated).

Defect 1 (R4): benchbox/platforms/snowflake.py:1726-1728 compares INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES.CLUSTERING_KEY (documented form 'LINEAR(A, B)') against a hand-built bare '(A, B)'. They can never be equal, so the 'already has desired clustering key' branch is dead and every reused-DB run re-issues ALTER TABLE ... CLUSTER BY plus RESUME RECLUSTER (snowflake.py:1730-1741) - Snowflake credit spend and silent re-arming of automatic reclustering on every reuse. Note the re-ALTER currently guarantees the ledger entry that corroboration depends on for reused DBs, so the fix must keep corroboration working (see preserves).

Defect 2 (SF1): snowflake_introspection.py:89-93 interpolates self._schema raw and case-sensitively into WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '{schema}'. Snowflake stores unquoted schemas uppercase, so a lowercase-configured schema returns zero rows -> every cluster intent ABSENT -> tuned Snowflake runs silently never verify. Also a config-controlled SQL-injection surface (a quote in the schema breaks the read; fails closed, still wrong).

Related smell to note in the same PR (no code change required): applied_verified on Snowflake certifies the clustering KEY in the catalog, not physical clustering - ALTER is metadata-instant, reclustering is async, and the RESUME RECLUSTER failure is swallowed at snowflake.py:1740-1741. Document the asymmetry vs ClickHouse (where CREATE-time keys are the physical layout) in the receipts design note.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not 'fix' the injection surface by escaping quotes into the f-string
anti_patterns.instead: parameterize or validate against a strict identifier pattern and uppercase unquoted names
anti_patterns.why: escaping is a denylist; identifier handling needs normalization plus parameterization or strict validation

anti_patterns.dont: Do not resolve the comparison by assuming LINEAR(...) is the one true catalog form
anti_patterns.instead: compare via parse_clustering_key normalization that accepts both forms
anti_patterns.why: the live shape is exactly what the tracked open item says is unconfirmed

anti_patterns.dont: Do not skip the ALTER without deciding what the ledger records for an already-clustered reused table
anti_patterns.instead: make the skip path explicit and tested end-to-end for the reused-DB status outcome
anti_patterns.why: the current always-re-ALTER is accidentally what makes reused-DB corroboration possible; silently skipping it changes verification behavior

preserves.behavior: Introspector never raises: all failures keep degrading to IntrospectedState(error=...), refusing the upgrade.
No live Snowflake calls in tests - unit-level fakes only; live confirmation stays in the tracked item.

Reused-DB corroboration keeps working: when the desired clustering key is already present and the ALTER is skipped, the run must still have an honest ledger/receipt story (skipped-as-already-clustered must not silently produce applied_verified without a corroboratable footprint, nor break the fresh-DB path).
parse_clustering_key keeps accepting both LINEAR(...) and bare forms until snowflake-clustering-key-live-verification-20260730 confirms the live shape.
